recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white portrait of a man looking downward, draped in a flag, heavily processed with horizontal digital glitch scanlines and a central horizontal black bar containing sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal scanlines intersecting the organic forms of the subject
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights
Text bar acting as a visual anchor and divider

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium close-up, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black horizontal bar containing the white text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central text bar, move up to the subject's face, then follow the flag's folds downward through the glitch texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject and dense horizontal texture.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from pure black to pure white.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Substitution of specific characters with symbols (e.g., currency signs for 'S')

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a solid black horizontal band

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist and title, separated by spacing or punctuation.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Professional grotesque feel with tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man looking down, draped in a flag. Apply heavy horizontal glitch effects, scanlines, and pixel-stretching across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid black horizontal bar across the center. Place white, bold, condensed sans-serif text in all caps inside the bar, centered.

verificationChecks: Are there visible horizontal glitch lines?
Is the text bar perfectly centered?

adjustableVariables: Width of the central black bar
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the individual

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between black and white
Legible typography despite the glitch background

postGenerationChecks: Check for any unintended color artifacts
Ensure the glitch lines are strictly horizontal
Verify the text is not distorted by the glitch effect
Confirm the subject's head is tilted down
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + horizontal glitch scanlines + central black text bar with condensed sans-serif.
